source_checks.source: JR East Tohoku General Service official Fukushima Pivot release (2026-11-24 16:00 JST)
source_checks.note: The detailed list specifies Kona's Coffee (Dec 3), GOZZO Fukushima, 七宝麻辣湯, 福島餃子 神楽, 凍天処 木乃幡, and 買取店わかば (Dec 11). The release's introduction says five stores; its detailed list contains six entries, of which 凍天処 木乃幡 is explicitly a relocation/renewal. All six named entries and dates were recorded as five new openings plus one relocation/renewal.
Corroborates コナズ珈琲 福島駅店, 2026-12-03, Fukushima City, Fukushima Prefecture, Fukushima Station West Exit Power City Pivot 1F.
